items.title: Banners autolink URLs and file paths
items.text: A bare `https://` URL or a `/`, `~/`, `./`, or `../` path in a pane banner is now clickable on its own — no `[text](url)` needed. Clicking a file link reveals it in Finder; Cmd-click opens it in a viewer, and the right-click menu adds Open in Side Pane and Copy Path. Dot-relative paths resolve against the pane's working directory.

items.title: Banner links look and behave like links
items.text: Links show a dotted underline at rest that goes solid on hover, and a right-click menu offers Side Pane / New Window / Default Browser / Copy Link. Clicking a link no longer collapses the banner out from under you.

items.title: Viewer panes get their own keyboard shortcuts
items.text: Cmd-R reloads the focused viewer in place and Cmd-D drops the caret into its address field with the address selected. Both apply only while a viewer holds focus, so they keep doing their usual thing in a terminal pane. Escape now cancels an address edit and hands focus back to the page.

items.title: `+send-keys` actually submits
items.text: `ghoztty +send-keys --target=pane "some message" Enter` now sends the message instead of leaving it parked unsent in the composer. Text is framed as a bracketed paste so the trailing Enter reads as a keypress rather than a newline inside pasted text.

items.title: What's New in Ghoztty…
items.text: A new menu window with Client and Agent tabs shows what changed in each, and the update chip's pre-update dialog now previews the incoming version's notes before you commit.
